counties.name: Tuscaloosa
gaps: 11646 source rows collapsed to 11596 parcel ids (duplicate ids, stacked units, or rings that failed the WGS84 check). The acreage query covered the county.
No sale price on the public parcel layer. lastSale.price stays null.
Acreage filter uses rtMAP_ACRE. rtDEED_ACR is often 0 and is not the filter.
deedDATE is stored as lastSale.date when present. There is no sale price field.
City of Tuscaloosa zoning is Zoning_Districts/3. Framework_Zoning_Map is a draft and was not joined.
Northport zoning is NorthportZoning_Dec2024, joined on pclNUM digits to Name/pclnum, then by centroid.
Northport future land use is FLU_240408, joined by centroid.

Hale, Pickens, and Greene counties are Flagship/CaptureCAMA HTML only in this pull. No usable public parcel REST. Polygons were not invented. Bibb County stays a Birmingham parcel gap for the same reason.
